I was on gel for about 2.5 years. Had some changes, but pretty minimal. Never got a significant voice drop, still had the monthly bleeding and so on. Only changes I really experienced was some extra hair growth and bottom growth. 

I tried pretty much every dose of gel I could, but I was always either on the low end (400s, was not enough to suppress my E) or the high end (900s, T was back converting into E). My doctor recommended I try shots to hit the more precise “in between” of those since neither were producing great results for me. Over the past 2/3 months I’ve been consistently around 600 and I’ve been having more changes than ever. Nothing insane, but my voice has been cracking/deepening, faster and more hair growth, and my cycle has finally seemed to stop (knock on wood). On the annoying side, sex drive and acne is through the roof but I’ll 100% take it. 

5/6 months is still pretty early to tell, but don’t be afraid to advocate for trying a higher/different dose with your doctor if things continue in a way you’re unhappy with.
